survey: A stone chess table with two round stools on a park lawn, all seen from one raised three-quarter view. The square tabletop is seen from above. Its inset checkerboard sits flush inside the rim, and the rows of squares run parallel to the top's edges and shrink slightly toward the back. Under the top, a flared, chamfered pedestal holds it up. The pedestal stands on a wider stepped plinth whose top face is also seen from above, in line with the tabletop's angle. The plinth sits flat on the grass with a soft contact shadow. The left stool, nearer the viewer, and the right stool, behind the table, each have an elliptical top. Both tops are about as open as the tabletop's tilt suggests, and each stool's waisted column stands upright on a round foot resting on the grass. The verticals of the pedestal and stools stay vertical, and the background path and trees match the same eye level.
